ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels to low-intensity (black/pigmented) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling is localized to the proximal upper-left lobe and the peripheral trailing edge of the left lobe. The right lobe is a contiguous low-intensity dark mass with isolated white pixel clusters in the lower-right (distal) quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 45 degrees and deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 5-15 pixels. The right lobe upper edge displays significant macro-indentations and a jagged, non-uniform boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a linear diagonal sweep with terminal convexity; right lobe follows a broader, descending convex parabolic curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast white clusters at the distal tip of the left lobe and a dense constellation of small circular spots on the lower right margin of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular structural loss or jagged trauma visible along the superior trailing edge of the right lobe, contrasting with the more uniform serrations of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast white water droplets and spray causing pixel-level noise/occlusion along the ventral-peduncle insertion area.
